referenceStatus: other-app audit supplied; production state not independently reverified in this turn

scope.appOnly: close the current maintenance app epoch; do not delete shared Auth
scope.sharedAccount: explicit separate request listing affected apps; cannot pass Kakei request/claim as a maintenance worker receipt
scope.production: no schema, permission, acceptance switch, real Auth or owner-data mutation

familyHandoff.required: before erasing an owned household with other members, ask whether to preserve it; default must not silently cascade family products/tasks/history
familyHandoff.recipient: existing active member explicitly accepts ownership before transfer
familyHandoff.atomicity: live owner, recipient membership/consent, target home and account epochs revalidated under shared write fences; transfer and deletion inventory committed together
familyHandoff.noRecipient: keep request awaiting decision; never choose a member automatically or use a timeout as consent
familyHandoff.scope: separate owner attribution and personal identifiers from shared maintenance records; preserve family history with reviewed attribution policy
familyHandoff.attachments: shared file ownership and quota transfer require recipient consent and backend support; storage paths cannot merely be relabeled
familyHandoff.currentGap: handoff not implemented in the maintenance deletion worker; existing owner-home cascade must not be activated for this shared-account design

orchestration.identity: one random coordinator request ID mapped to exact per-app user/epoch/request IDs; service-only evidence, no client-supplied ownership
orchestration.preflight: verified recent identity, affected-app inventory, family consent, export and Apple cancellation explanation
orchestration.requested: cancellable until atomic processing claim; UI reports server state
orchestration.processing: per-app writes/rejoin/ownership changes fenced; no general cancellation promise after destructive work begins
orchestration.partialFailure: persist per-app progress and exact retry checkpoints; completed steps are not repeated; do not mark the overall account complete
orchestration.resume: renew worker lease after live scope/state check; stale callbacks may not update replacement requests
orchestration.appComplete: verified durable app closure, attachment deletion, notification shutdown, preserved family data and explicitly reviewed billing retention
orchestration.authDeletion: only after every affected app is complete and family handoff readback verified; shared session revocation/JWT write denial tested first; Auth admin API only
orchestration.overallComplete: Auth deletion readback plus all app receipts; missing cascaded Kakei request row alone proves nothing
orchestration.race: coordinator processing claim does not itself fence app writes; all relevant mutations must join the same per-user/per-home boundary

notification.proposal: outbox created before Auth deletion, outside any auth.users cascade; requires explicit verified contact consent
notification.payload: random delivery ID, verified contact encrypted server-side, locale, completion status; no household contents or purchase identifiers
notification.send: separate worker after durable overall completion, idempotent delivery; delivery timeout remains unknown and must not imply success
notification.retentionProposal: retry delivery for 7 days; erase contact after verified delivery or at 30 days maximum; retain only non-personal aggregate delivery outcome after purge
notification.privacy: review lawful purpose and provider retention before enabling; do not claim removal of external mail copies
notification.statusAfterAuth: optional expiring receipt token stored hashed server-side, exposes only exact request completion; design and abuse review required

requiredSyntheticTests: shared owner with family: no silent cascade
recipient missing/removed/declines: no transfer or delete
recipient accepts: original shared products/tasks/history preserved
two competing transfers: one atomic winner
app-only request never invokes shared Auth deletion
cancel before claim succeeds; after irreversible start refused honestly
partial app failure blocks overall complete and Auth deletion
lost acknowledgment rereads exact request without repeating completed step
replacement epoch cannot consume old receipt
stale worker lease or callback refused
Auth row cascade does not erase outbox completion evidence
notification timeout/retry preserves honest delivery state and prevents duplicated job
retention purge removes encrypted contact and expired receipt access
